content: A drop of water falling on red-hot iron evaporates into nothing; the same drop falling on a lotus leaf shines like a radiant pearl.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Ayyah-santapta-ayasi samsthitam (अयःसन्तप्ते पयसो नामापि न ज्ञायते) — Bhartrihari's Niti Shataka
explanation: The nature of the water drop remains identical, yet in the company of burning iron it is hissed out of existence, while in the embrace of the pure lotus leaf it reflects the morning sun like a diamond. Your destiny, character, and peace are shaped by the company you keep.
practicalInsight: Audit your inner circle. Spend time today with people whose presence elevates your thoughts toward virtue and peace.
reflectionPrompt: Are the environments and friendships you frequent evaporating your peace or helping your soul shine like a pearl?
